answer: Mechanism: Rotating Synchronous Quorum (RSQ). Identities are partitioned into unpredictable shards—grove, lagoon, reef—that rotate. To act, an identity must join a live 20-second window and complete a randomized perceptual micro-task with its current shard. The scarce resource is synchronous attention and unique real-time presence, not capital. A sybil must supply a distinct live participant for every identity across random windows, incurring continuous scheduling and attention cost; missed windows freeze the identity.
